symptom: An MCP server with "Also listens on" that failed to start kept its launcher in the engine's pool after its process was stopped, and the pool's 64-server limit counted it. A failing server in the user's own settings added one entry per workspace folder, until a working server elsewhere was refused with "Too many MCP servers are running."
rule: A capacity limit counts only what is held: release a failed entry once its cleanup is proven, keep it while the cleanup still needs a retry, and test the limit after many failures. Principle 8.
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/agents/gateway/__tests__/launched-servers.test.ts -t 'failed to start'
